entryWatch.setup: MDT day-3 pullback INTO the post-earnings base - THE SPECIFICATION WAS WITHDRAWN AT 10:21 AND THE TAPE HAS SINCE REVERSED. This row was still published as armed at level 92.01 an hour after the kill; corrected at 11:21.
entryWatch.trigger: DEAD BY WITHDRAWAL, NOT BY EXPIRY, AND THE LEVEL IS NOT RE-STRUCK. The 09:47 buy of 4 MDT at a 92.01 limit was killed by the 10:21 hourly on two of its own five published invalidations, five hours before its 15:30 fuse. RE-QUOTED LIVE THIS RUN: MDT 92.34 bid / 92.38 ask at 2026-09-03T15:22:42.517011493Z, last 92.36, +0.20% against a 92.18 settled close, on a 0.04 spread that is 0.043% of mark. THE KILL LANDED WITHIN ONE BAR OF THE SESSION LOW: the low was 90.965 in the 14:10Z bar covering 10:10-10:20 ET and the withdrawal was written at 10:21, since when MDT has rallied 1.375 - a 91.08-91.67 base through 14:30Z to 14:50Z, then 91.63 to 92.10 on 143,662 shares in the 15:00Z bar, then 92.08 to 92.4679 with a 92.48 high in the 15:10Z bar. COST OF THE KILL, WITH ARITHMETIC: the 10:21 offer was 91.13 and the 92.01 limit was marketable through it, so an execution then fills near 91.13; against the 92.34 bid now that is 1.21 a share, 4.84 on four shares, +1.33% on the 364.52 it would have cost, +0.48% of the account. The 92.01 limit is now UNFILLABLE, 0.37 BELOW the offer, having gone through inside the 15:00Z bar whose high was 92.10 - so the window in which the kill cost anything ran roughly 10:06 to 11:05 ET and has shut.
entryWatch.why: THE KILL STANDS AS CORRECT PROCESS AND IT STILL COST 4.84, AND BOTH HALVES ARE WRITTEN DOWN. Invalidation four - MDT session return below XLV - HAS FULLY UN-FIRED: MDT +0.20% against XLV -0.13% is a +0.33 point edge restored from the -0.35 that fired it, and MDT is now FIRST of five medtech peers and the only green one, SYK -0.98%, ZBH -0.50%, BSX -1.98%, ABT -1.47%, against fourth of five when the entry was struck and second of five when it was killed. Invalidation one CANNOT un-fire: it was a trade below the 91.47 session low and a 90.965 print is a permanent fact that no recovery edits. That asymmetry is the whole answer. An entry that publishes five invalidations against itself and then declines to honour a fired one is not running a process, and 4.84 on this particular hour is what honouring it was worth. THE LEVEL IS NOT RE-STRUCK AND THE REFUSAL IS DOUBLE: it was withdrawn on a fired invalidation, and it now sits below the offer, so reaching the tape would mean raising a dead level to chase a name that got away - the behaviour the 2026-08-18 rule change names as the one this board has refused most often. THE COUNTERFACTUAL IS ALSO WORTH ONLY WHAT IT IS: with sixteen recorded delivery misses and four consecutive specifications expiring unexecuted, the 4.84 assumes an execution this board’s own record says probably would not have happened. That is a caveat, not an excuse - the price arithmetic is unchanged either way. Recorded prominently because a board that publishes its kills only when they are vindicated is running an advertisement, and the 8/31 SJM kill was vindicated in a number fourteen minutes later while this one is not.

entryWatch.setup: OLLI day-2 after the 9/2 am print - THE CANDIDATE THIS BOARD PRE-REGISTERED YESTERDAY, AND IT FAILED ITS OWN PRE-REGISTERED TEST
entryWatch.trigger: REFUSED ON STRUCTURE, NOT ON THE BEAT. OLLI is 71.11 bid / 71.37 ask at 2026-09-03T13:42:46.561401548Z, last 71.1988, -3.62% against a 73.87 settled close. That is BELOW BOTH its 72.34 pre-print close AND the 73.02 low of its own reaction bar. The reaction bar opened 76.00, ran 78.69, and closed 73.87 on 4,832,306 shares against roughly 1.2M typical - it gave back nearly the whole gap on the day, and today took out the rest. This is the completed round trip that killed SAIC and NTNX, arriving on day 2.
entryWatch.why: THIS IS WHAT A PRE-REGISTERED TEST IS FOR. The 9/2 file wrote that OLLI was worth the 9/3 and 9/4 opens' attention IF IT BUILT A SHELF, on the same terms SAIC was given and failed and MDT was given and passed. The test was written yesterday with nothing at stake, applied this morning, and it DISQUALIFIED THE NAME THIS BOARD EXPECTED TO BUY. A 22.4% beat - 1.42 against 1.16 - is not the question; the question was whether the gap held its pre-print close, and it did not. Recorded prominently because the alternative reading, that the board went looking for a reason to prefer the name it already owned an opinion on, is the failure this row exists to rule out.

entryWatch.setup: MDT options - the standing spread finding, RE-TESTED ON THE STRONGEST CASE THIS BOARD CAN CONSTRUCT
entryWatch.trigger: REFUSED ON SPREAD, BY 3.4x, ON A 117.6 BILLION DOLLAR BLUE CHIP. MDT's 11/17 print clears a 3-6 week expiry outright, so for once the no-earnings-hold rule did not settle the question first and the spread had to answer it. The 10/09 weeklies are unusable: 90c 2.80/5.00, mark 3.90, 56.4% of mark, OI 8; 91c 2.25/3.90, mark 3.075, 53.7%, OI 25; 92c 1.84/3.60, mark 2.72, 64.7%, OI 2 - all volume 0. THE LIQUID 10/16 MONTHLY WAS THEN TESTED RATHER THAN SKIPPED: 92.5c 2.51/3.55, mark 3.03, 34.3% of mark, OI 843, delta 0.514; 90c 3.85/5.40, mark 4.625, 33.5%, OI 1550, delta 0.635. All quoted live at 13:46Z.
entryWatch.why: THIS IS A STRONGER STATEMENT OF THE FINDING THAN THE SMALL-CAP VERSIONS IT HAS RESTED ON. Affordability PASSES - 303 and 463 against 1011.15 deployable. Delta PASSES - 0.514 and 0.635 against a 0.40 floor. Expiry PASSES. Earnings-clearance PASSES. Open interest PASSES at 843 and 1550. ONLY SPREAD FAILS, and it fails by more than three times the ceiling on a mega-cap's most liquid monthly. The 2026-08-10 rule change said the deposit answered the affordability half of the option finding and none of the spread half, and that options become available when a chain quotes inside 10% rather than when the account grows. This is that claim tested properly rather than assumed: no balance narrows a 34% spread, and equity on the identical name quotes 0.141%. Refusing options without checking the expiry that actually carries the open interest would have been a weak test, so the monthly was pulled.

AND IT IS BLOCKED BY ARITHMETIC INDEPENDENTLY OF ANY VIEW: one single share at 499.20 is 49.4% of the 1011.15 account, over the 40% single-name ceiling, so the SMALLEST POSITION THAT EXISTS is unbuyable. A 44.3% beat, 7.04 against 4.88, and it does not matter.
entryWatch.why: Kept because the mechanical half is the more interesting one and is easy to forget: at this account size a 500 dollar share price puts a name out of reach entirely, and no thesis can argue with that. It is the same shape as the 2026-08-05 option finding - the universe's arithmetic rather than three unlucky picks. Worth re-reading the next time a run builds a case for a high-priced name before checking whether one share fits.

entryWatch.setup: SAIC post-earnings reversal - the control case has RECLAIMED its pre-print close, and the row is updated in the direction that is less flattering to this board
entryWatch.trigger: STILL REFUSED, BUT THE REFUSAL NOW COSTS SOMETHING. SAIC is 125.88 bid / 127.44 ask at 2026-09-03T13:42:46.012185728Z, last 126.83, -0.28% against a 127.18 settled close. It closed 9/2 at 127.18 - which is ABOVE its 125.96 pre-print close - having been 123.50 and breaking down when this board quoted it yesterday. So the name the board used for five sessions as its worked example of a failed beat has turned and reclaimed the exact line the example was built on. Refused today on a 1.23% spread, nine times MDT's, and because three lower sessions followed by one bounce is not a base.
entryWatch.why: MOVED FROM DEAD TO WATCH AND SAID OUT LOUD RATHER THAN QUIETLY DROPPED. SAIC was this board's control case: a 30.9% beat that round-tripped its pre-print close on day 2 and kept going, cited repeatedly as the reason MDT was bought instead. That comparison is now weaker than it was, because SAIC recovered. It does NOT invalidate the test - the test is about what the tape does with the gap, and SAIC did lose the line for three sessions before reclaiming it, which is a different and worse path than never losing it. But a board that cites a control case while it flatters the argument and stops updating it when it turns is running an advertisement. So it is updated on the hour it looks wrong.
